reason: A Web UI theme and layout plugin that adds a cursor-reactive animated particle-whale background with light and dark theme support.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加支持明暗主题和鼠标互动光效的粒子鲸鱼背景动画。
summaries.en: Adds a cursor-reactive particle-whale background animation to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with light and dark theme support.

capabilities: Adds a decorative particle-based whale background to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
Responds to cursor movement for hover displacement and flashlight lighting
Supports light and dark visual themes
Renders a browser-side canvas animation at a stated 30 FPS
